title: bowtie smoke
description: Smoke test results for supported implementation(s)

oneOf.description: Multiple implementations' results, nested by their ID.

result.title: Smoke Result
result.description: A collection of possible warnings or errors encountered while checking an implementation (harness).

unsupportedImplicitDialects.description: Dialect shortnames for which the harness declined out-of-band dialect selection. A warning only; it does not make the smoke test fail.

dialects.description: The shortnames of the dialects confirmed in the smoke test, all of which would have passed.

registry.description: If present and false, indicates the implementation failed a simple $ref keyword smoke test.

additionalProperties.description: A mapping from dialect shortnames to results received while checking their support. Non-empty arrays will contain at least one failure.
additionalProperties.$todo: Standardize how we represent discrepant results.
